acceptance_criteria.statement: A local-real fixture produces an actual implementation and tests in isolated Git worktrees, passes independent verification and governed integration, reconciles Jira, recomputes state, survives restart and worker loss, continues an unaffected lane, and selects next work automatically.

definition_of_done: All sixteen golden-journey behaviors are observed.
Real Git/worktree mutations occur in an isolated fixture.
Every material transition has durable evidence.
description: Prove the complete local-real autonomous product journey; mocked remote boundaries may support isolation but cannot replace real Git, implementation, verification, restart, incident, continuation, and state recomputation behavior.
exclusions: No generated evidence without observed behavior.
objective: Prove the complete local-real autonomous golden journey
observability_impact: Expose every operation, state transition, receipt, incident, reconciliation, and next-selection result.
rationale: Component composition evidence does not qualify the complete product behavior.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Use disposable fixture repositories and content-addressed checkpoints; preserve failed-run evidence.
security_impact: Uses isolated fixtures and capability-scoped credentials/references only.
title: Local-real autonomous golden journey
